func New() *Index
func Search(ctx context.Context, q Query, k int, fuse Fuser, scorers ...Scorer) ([]Candidate, error)
func Tokenize(s string) []string
func TopK(cands []Candidate, k int) []Candidate
method Index.Add(d Document) (DocID, error)
method Index.AvgDocLen() float64
method Index.Doc(id DocID) (Document, bool)
method Index.DocLen(id DocID) int
method Index.Len() int
method Index.Lookup(term string) []Posting
method Index.Resolve(key string) (DocID, bool)
method Index.Stats() (docs int, avgDocLen float64)
type Candidate struct
field Candidate.Doc DocID
field Candidate.Score float64
type DocID uint32
type Document struct
field Document.Key string
field Document.Text string
field Document.Vector []float32
field Document.Links []string
field Document.Time time.Time
type Fuser func(streams [][]Candidate, k int) []Candidate
type Index struct
type Posting struct
field Posting.Doc DocID
field Posting.Freq int
type Query struct
field Query.Text string
field Query.Vector []float32
field Query.Seeds []string
type Scorer interface
method Scorer.Name() string
method Scorer.Candidates(ctx context.Context, q Query, k int) ([]Candidate, error)
var ErrDuplicateKey
var ErrEmptyKey
var ErrNoFuser
var ErrNonFiniteVector
